items.title: Why Entergy Stock Is In Focus As Investors Look To Regulated Utilities
items.summary: Politics just crashed into the AI build out story, and that collision is rippling through everything from data center builders to the regulated utilities that keep them powered. When expectations for US AI infrastructure cool, capital often looks for steadier cash flows and clearer rulebooks instead of pure hype. This article walks through three regulated utilities that sit in the crosshairs of this shift, all tied in different ways to the same headline shock. The companies highlighted next...
